stories.title: One in four Wrexham Maelor AE patients spent 12 hours or more there in October
stories.summary: Just over a third of patients at Wrexham Maelor Hospital’s emergency department were seen within four hours in October, new Welsh Government figures show. stories.summary: LINK, which runs the UK’s cash machine network, will carry out a new assessment of Holywell’s banking needs after the town lost its last bank. stories.title: Flintshire railway stations have busiest year on record, ORR figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire’s railway stations were used more than ever last year, with almost 943,000 entries and exits across the county’s nine stations. Figures from the Office of Rail and Road (ORR), published today (Thursday, 19 November), show use rose at every station in Flintshire between April 2025 and March 2026. stories.title: Six sheep die after being chased by dog on Cilcain Mountain
stories.summary: Six sheep have died on Cilcain Mountain after being chased and cornered by a dog, North Wales Police has said. stories.title: Power cut hits part of Mancot and Aston with supply due back by 2pm
stories.summary: Update, 13:30 19 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report: Part of Mancot and Aston is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 2pm.
